entries.tutorialSubtitle: rich, crumbly butter cookies with tahini and toasted black sesame seeds
entries.tutorialExcerpt: Black sesame cookies are rich, crumbly butter cookies made with tahini and toasted black sesame seeds. The black sesame gives a deep, roasted, slightly nutty flavour and a striking dark-speckled appearance against the pale dough. The tahini in the dough adds softness and amplifies the sesame flavour. The cookies are short and tender, not chewy.
